See, for example, “Global Histories,”ChurchofJesusChrist.org. Here you will find inspiring true stories of Church members around the world who have dedicated their lives to establishing the Church in their home countries.

For example, the Church has worked to make genealogical records such as those from the Freedman’s Savings and Trust Company available so that Black Americans can find and learn from their family records; see “African American Freedman’s Savings and Trust Company Records” on FamilySearch.org to learn more.

The Church has also worked with groups such as the NAACP to promote civil rights; see, for example, “First Presidency and NAACP Leaders Announce a Shared Vision to ‘Learn from and Serve One Another,’” June 14, 2021, newsroom.ChurchofJesusChrist.org.
